::: {#def-data-set}

#### Data set

A **data set** is a finite collection of $\nobs$ labelled observations,
that is, $\nobs$ pairs $(\vpredvar_\iobs, \outvar_\iobs)$,
where $\vpredvar_\iobs$ is an input vector
and $\outvar_\iobs$ is the corresponding outcome:

$$
\dataset \eqdef \set{(\vpredvar_\iobs, \outvar_\iobs) : i = 1, \ldots, \nobs} .
$$ {#eq-data-set}

:::
